SELECT TABLE_NAME, 
COLUMN_NAME, 
CASE WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'nvarchar' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'varchar' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'char' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'numeric' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'decimal' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE IN ('datetime','datetime2', 'date', 'int', 'bigint', 'tinyint', 'float', 'smallint','bit','time') THEN DATA_TYPE
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'bit' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')'
	 END AS DATA_TYPE,
	 LEFT(IS_NULLABLE,1) IS_NULLABLE			 
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 
WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('dimcustomeraccountproduct') and TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dw'
ORDER BY 1


select count(1) null_cnt from dw.dimcustomeraccountproduct
where
CustomerAccountProductSK is null or
CustomerSK is null or
CustomerID is null or
AccountSK is null or
AccountID is null 

select count(1) dup_cnt  from (
select CustomerID, AccountID, ProductID, BankSK, CustomerSourceSystemCode, AccountSourceSystemCode, count(1) cnt from dw.dimcustomeraccountproduct
group by  CustomerID, AccountID, ProductID, BankSK, CustomerSourceSystemCode, AccountSourceSystemCode
having count(1)>1 ) a


with Loans_Closed AS (
    SELECT AccountSK FROM DW.DimAccount
    WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' AND AccountStatus = 'Closed'
)
select 'Source' Tables, count(1) CNT from (
        SELECT 
		DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
	FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
	LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
		ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA
		ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK AND DA.CurrentIndicator = 1
	LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount CA
		ON DCA.AccountID = CA.CustomerAccountID
	LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountProduct DAP
        ON DCA.AccountSK = DAP.AccountSK AND DAP.CurrentIndicator = 1
	LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DP
		ON DAP.ProductSK = DP.ProductSK AND DP.CurrentIndicator = 1 
	WHERE DC.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND DCA.AccountSK NOT IN (SELECT * FROM Loans_Closed) 
		) a
UNION ALL
select 'Target' Tables, count(1) CNT FROM dw.dimcustomeraccountproduct





WITH Base AS (
	SELECT 
		DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
		,DC.CustomerID AS CustomerID
		,DC.GlobalCIF AS GlobalCIF
		,DC.FCBSCIF AS FCBSCIF
		,DC.BankSK AS BankSK
		,DC.SourceSystemCode AS CustomerSourceSystemCode
		,DCA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
		,DCA.AccountID AS AccountID
		,DA.AccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
		,CA.CustomerAccountClosedDate AS AccountClosedDate
		,DA.AccountStatus AS AccountStatus
		,DCA.SourceSystemCode AS AccountSourceSystemCode
		,DAP.ProductSK AS ProductSK
		,DAP.ProductID AS ProductID
		,DP.ProductName AS ProductName
		,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGroup
		,DAP.CurrentIndicator AS CurrentIndicator
		,DAP.ValidStartDate AS ValidStartDate
		,DAP.ValidEndDate AS ValidEndDate
		,0 AS WorkFlowID
		,0 AS TaskRunID
		,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
	FROM DW.DimCustomer DC
	LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
		ON DC.CustomerSK = DCA.CustomerSK AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = 1
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA
		ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK AND DA.CurrentIndicator = 1
	LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount CA
		ON DCA.AccountID = CA.CustomerAccountID
	LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountProduct DAP
        ON DCA.AccountSK = DAP.AccountSK AND DAP.CurrentIndicator = 1
	LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct DP
		ON DAP.ProductSK = DP.ProductSK AND DP.CurrentIndicator = 1 
	WHERE DC.CurrentIndicator = 1
		
)

,CustomerAccountProductSK AS (
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerAccountProductSK),0) RN FROM dw.DimCustomerAccountProduct
)
 ,Cascade_FCBS AS (
	SELECT
    A.CustomerSK,A.CustomerID,A.GlobalCIF
    ,A.FCBSCIF AS FCBSCIF
    ,A.BankSK,A.CustomerSourceSystemCode,B.AccountSK
    ,B.AccountID,B.AccountOpenedDate,B.AccountClosedDate,B.AccountStatus,B.AccountSourceSystemCode,B.ProductSK,B.ProductID,B.ProductName
    ,B.ProductGroup,B.CurrentIndicator,B.ValidStartDate,B.ValidEndDate,
    B.WorkFlowID AS WorkFlowId
    ,B.TaskRunID AS TaskRunId
    ,B.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
    FROM Base A LEFT JOIN Base B ON A.FCBSCIF = B.FCBSCIF
    WHERE A.FCBSCIF IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
    A.CustomerSK,A.CustomerID,A.GlobalCIF,A.FCBSCIF,A.BankSK,A.CustomerSourceSystemCode,B.AccountSK
    ,B.AccountID,B.AccountOpenedDate,B.AccountClosedDate,B.AccountStatus,B.AccountSourceSystemCode,B.ProductSK,B.ProductID,B.ProductName
    ,B.ProductGroup,B.CurrentIndicator,B.ValidStartDate,B.ValidEndDate,B.WorkFlowID,B.TaskRunID,B.InsertDttm
)
, Cascade_NoFCBS AS (
	SELECT 
    CustomerSK,CustomerID,GlobalCIF
    ,FCBSCIF AS FCBSCIF
    ,BankSK,CustomerSourceSystemCode,AccountSK
    ,AccountID,AccountOpenedDate,AccountClosedDate,AccountStatus,AccountSourceSystemCode,ProductSK,ProductID,ProductName
    ,ProductGroup,CurrentIndicator,ValidStartDate,ValidEndDate
    ,WorkFlowID AS WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunID AS TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
    FROM Base
    WHERE FCBSCIF IS NULL
)
, Loans_Closed AS (
    SELECT AccountSK FROM DW.DimAccount
    WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' AND AccountStatus = 'Closed'
)
, [Result] AS(
SELECT * FROM Cascade_FCBS WHERE AccountSK NOT IN (SELECT * FROM Loans_Closed)
UNION
SELECT * FROM Cascade_NoFCBS WHERE AccountSK NOT IN (SELECT * FROM Loans_Closed)
)

select 'Source' Tables, count(1) CNT from [Result]
UNION ALL
select 'Target' Tables, count(1) CNT FROM dw.dimcustomeraccountproduct
